_doc: Explosions and shots. Airblast: Kingery-Bulmash curves for a hemispherical TNT surface burst as simplified by Swisdak, M. M., 'Simplified Kingery Airblast Calculations', 26th DoD Explosives Safety Seminar, Aug 1994 (DTIC ADA526744), F = exp(A + B ln Z + C ln2 Z + ...), Z = R / W^(1/3) in m/kg^(1/3), pressure in kPa, impulse in kPa-ms divided by W^(1/3); outside the Z range of the first/last row the value is that of the nearest end (DDESB TP 20, 11 Jun 2018, 2.4.3.2). Positive phase duration td (ms, times W^(1/3)) from the same Swisdak fits. A building answers to the load it feels: the peak pressure times min(1, td / response_ms) (an impulsive load shorter than the structure's own response is felt as a fraction of its peak, the pressure-impulse idea of UFC 3-340-02); response_ms is a design value (low-rise masonry is of the order of 0.1 s; not measured here). Damage by overpressure: Glasstone & Dolan, The Effects of Nuclear Weapons, 3rd ed. 1977: 5.131 a two-storey brick house at 5 psi (34.5 kPa) is demolished; 5.132 light industrial buildings at 3 psi (20.7 kPa) suffer extensively; Fig 5.89 and 5.104 trucks overturned and utility poles collapsed at 5 psi; windows break at about 1 psi (6.9 kPa). People: Glasstone & Dolan table 12.38 (effective peak pressure): lethality threshold 40 psi (275.8 kPa), 50 percent 62 psi (427.5 kPa); eardrum rupture threshold 5 psi (34.5 kPa), 50 percent 15-20 psi (120.7 kPa); each is a log-normal probit through its two points (the pulses of that table are long, so small charges are judged on the safe side for the victim; DDESB TP 20 2.7.3 gives the short-pulse lung model and is kept in the research notes); noise: 140 dB re 20 uPa (200 Pa) is the threshold of pain. Design values with no published measurement (shot.*: the pistol of the reference game: head 100, trunk 34, limb 20 of 100 health, a limb comes off at 40 taken, the trunk opens at 3 hits, 12 hits burst a car), (behaviour of the 4.0 kept as reference, listed in the report): people.knock_* seconds down, panic_s and panic_gain (a walker breaks into a run), sever_chance, maim_chance, strike.hold_growth_s, fire_*, wear_gain. torn_kpa is the 100 percent lethality of table 12.38 (92 psi). Charge: design choice, strength S (1..50, the player's force) is W = charge_kg_per_s2 * S^2 kg of TNT (force 5 = 50 kg, force 50 = 5 t). Crater: pass_width_m is the widest vehicle allowed on Brazilian roads (CONTRAN Resolucao 210/2006: 2.60 m): a crater that leaves a strip narrower than that cuts the road. Crater: radius scales with W^(1/3) (OSTI 6538779), depth is the diameter over 7 (OSTI 4833696 gives 6 to 8); the soil factors are design values inside the literature's range, not measurements.
